courses.subject: PPE
courses.title: Introduction to Philosophy, Politics, and Economics
courses.description: Cultivate an awareness of the relevance of ethics, politics, and economics, as well as an appreciation for the limitations of each discipline and the necessity of thinking through their interactions. Three lecture hours a week for one semester.

courses.subject: PPE
courses.title: Foundations of Philosophy, Politics, and Economics
courses.description: Examine distributive justice, collective action, and the rule of law. Reflect on how these approaches amplify and limit civil discourse. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Philosophy, Politics, and Economics 301 with at least a C or consent of the director of the program.
